activity.notes: Wonggu (c.1880-1959) was a senior elder of the Djapu, a Yolngu clan of north-east Arnhem Land, and an influential Aboriginal leader during the Caledon Bay crisis and its aftermath. The Australian Dictionary of Biography summarizes his leadership period as 1930-1959; ATLAS therefore uses c.1930 to his death on 7 June 1959.
